name: Kizuna Zero
source:
Residents start to disappear in an old provincial town. But later they start to return possessing violent intentions. A mysterious group begins its operation at the same time with the incidents.
Main character discovers a crimson ring at the ruins, and from that moment he becomes in the center of these strange events.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-july-2004-dear-my-friend.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在一个古老的乡下小镇，居民们开始消失。但后来他们开始带着暴力意图回来。一个神秘组织在同一时间与这些事件一起开始了行动。主人公在废墟中发现了一枚深红色的戒指，从那一刻起他成为了这些奇怪事件的中心。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-july-2004-dear-my-friend.html]vndbreview[/url]]
